name: specdev
description: Spec-driven delivery pipeline: GitHub PR gates, fully-automatic deployment, post-dev and post-deploy QA, and a generated REQ->ADR->test->commit->release traceability matrix. Pairs arckit-style spec/architecture artifacts with a superpowers-style brainstorm->plan->TDD build. Includes the arch-config skill for capturing per-environment runtime hosting configuration. Adds CI handoff: start a build locally and finish it unattended in a GitHub runner (prod/poc modes). Includes the adr skill for guided, conflict-checked architecture decision records.
